zh.headline: 月之暗面发布 Kimi K3：2.8 万亿参数开源模型，性能逼近 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Claude Fable 5
zh.observation: 今天的核心信号是**开源模型的全面爆发**：Kimi K3（2.8T 参数）、Inkling（975B）、Soofi S（30B）在同一天发布，标志着开源模型在规模和性能上正在逼近闭源前沿。与此同时，Agent 安全成为行业焦点——GPT-Red 的自动化红队测试、xAI 的 Grok Build 数据泄露、Codex 文件删除 Bug 接连出现，说明 Agent 的安全治理已从"要不要做"进入"怎么做"的阶段。另一个值得注意的趋势是硬件端的探索：OpenAI 的 Codex Micro 和 LM Studio Bionic 都试图为 AI Agent 设计新的交互界面，暗示 Agent 正在从纯软件走向软硬一体的新形态。

en.headline: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3: 2.8 trillion parameter open-source model, approaching GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5
en.observation: The core signal today is the **explosive release of open-source models**: Kimi K3 (2.8T params), Inkling (975B), and Soofi S (30B) all launched on the same day, marking that open-source models are approaching frontier closed-source models in both scale and performance. Meanwhile, agent security has become an industry focus—GPT-Red's automated red-teaming, xAI's Grok Build data leak, and Codex's file deletion bug emerged in succession, indicating agent security governance has moved from "whether to do it" to "how to do it." Another notable trend is hardware exploration: both OpenAI's Codex Micro and LM Studio Bionic are attempting to design new interaction interfaces for AI agents, suggesting agents are moving from pure software to a software-hardware integrated form.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Codex file deletion bug sparks agent security debate
items.desc: OpenAI responded that the issue primarily occurs in "full access mode" without sandboxing, where the model mistakenly deletes the $HOME directory. This sparked widespread discussion on Hacker News and Twitter about AI agent security boundaries, with developers calling for sandboxing and auto-review by default. Source: [Simon Willison](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jul/16/bad-codex-bug/)

items.title: Linus Torvalds publicly endorses AI
items.desc: In the Linux kernel mailing list, Linus stated "Linux is not an anti-AI project," arguing AI is a tool like compilers, and those who disagree can fork or walk away. This stance sparked heated debate in the developer community, seen as a significant turning point in open source attitudes toward AI. Source: [InfoQ](https://www.infoq.cn/article/6WyXSL8U09AT6dWV1RNq)
